pr_body: This pull request adds `Buffer.prototype.toInt([radix])` to `node:buffer`. Solves https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/42871
pr_comments:
> I think people will have different expectations on how the implementation should behave

FWIW, when I saw the name of the function, I assumed it would convert the `Buffer` to a `BigInt` (similarly to #23071). If this is about _parsing_ the contents of the buffer, and if it is compatible with `parseInt`, then it should probably be named `parseInt`. I agree with @mscdex though and am not sure if this should exist in core at all.

issue_context.title: Supporting ascii array to number conversion using Number.fromCharCode
comments: For Node.js, we cannot extend the API of the standard `Number` built-in but we can consider adding this as an API under the `util` or `buffer` modules, e.g. `require('buffer').fromCharCode(...)`

This utility is a one-liner, and its use case seems pretty narrow, I wonder if it's not better left to userland.
```js
const numberFromCharCode = (codes, radix = undefined) => Number(String.fromCharCode(...codes), radix)
```

One liner solution provides the most unoptimized solution, because it first converts the array into string and then to a number using a parseInt. I believe a more thorough implementation is required to deliver a performant solution.
This seems incredibly niche to exist in the node stdlib or js stdlib.
Thank you for your input @aduh95. I believe it would be more performant if we wrote this in C++ in Node.js. What do you think?
Jumping between js and c++ is very expensive. You might have some luck if you use v8's fast call api but i'd still be skeptical.

Thanks @Slayer95 for the examples. You're absolutely right! My proposal was to add a function to convert a buffer to number. I think we should first get a consensus on whether node.js should support this or not.
The best way to reach consensus would be to open a pr with an implementation that you think to be the best. Wanna give that a shot?
Yes, of course. I'll open a pull request.
